scope: All LCV2025 member rows unresolved under scorecard-resolution-v1.3; existing source and analysis artifacts unchanged.
notes: Raw congressional identity records are the retained unitedstates/congress-legislators community source, not a new federal agency acquisition.
Every source name and context was reread from original CSV and corroborated against original HTML. Candidate name fields were read from original JSON and compared with pinned Parquet.
District/surname-based diagnostic candidates are evidence for explaining a failed exact match, not verified identity links. No fuzzy matcher, override or resolver change was applied.

No row is classified as an ambiguous exact match: existing resolver candidate_count is zero for 58 and one rejected historical candidate for four. Absence from the exact-name index does not mean the person is absent from congressional data.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Preserve primary name.middle, name.nickname and name.official_full from the already retained congressional identity source; index exact source-stated forms with historical term context and collision refusal.
proposed_improvements.limit: A proposal, not an applied change. Names and raw observations must remain source-faithful; never generate common nickname dictionaries.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Consider explicit source-specific parsing of parenthetical name forms for Jim Moylan and Zach Nunn, with literal source fields retained.
proposed_improvements.limit: Do not strip arbitrary parenthetical text or infer unrelated aliases.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Evaluate a versioned diacritic-folded exact comparison over the full pinned name corpus, requiring unique historical context and preserving the original accented values.
proposed_improvements.limit: Measure candidate collisions before admission. This diagnostic group does not authorize automatic matching.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Parse a state-prefixed district only when the prefix exactly agrees with the independently stated source state; preserve the literal district.
proposed_improvements.limit: 43 unresolved rows carry this diagnostic, but name or term failures coexist. No claim that parsing districts alone resolves 43 people.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Keep the four 2026-only members unresolved for the 2025 edition; investigate publisher roster-versus-rating period semantics before changing the temporal rule.
proposed_improvements.limit: Do not assign a 2025 historical term to a later member.

proposed_improvements.proposal: For remaining name-component, unstated-name-variant and Ogles discrepancies, obtain explicit identifier or publisher-backed alias evidence before considering a versioned override.
proposed_improvements.limit: A shared district or plausible nickname is not sufficient identity evidence.
